crm_notes:
Lead background: RivetLane builds an in-app product assistant and analytics layer for mid-market SaaS. Evaluating Redwood for embeddings+rerank and chat features. 

POC summary: Hosted API POC completed (small dataset). Results: relevance lift vs current vector baseline (+12%), embeddings latency median ~30ms, chat median ~120ms. They saw token cost reduction potential with caching suggestions.

Customer quotes / paraphrase: "We can't have PII leave our VPC without explicit controls — SOC2 and audit logs are must-haves" — Oliver (CTO). "Need predictable unit economics; if Dedicated offers a 20%+ discount for committed capacity we'll move fast." — Head of Product.

Security asks (explicit): VPC peering or Private deployment, SAML SSO integration to Okta, SOC2 Type II evidence, per-request audit logs retained for 6 months (they may relax to 90 days), KMS integration or HSM-backed key storage, ability to set retention TTL per dataset, data residency in us-west region.

Technical constraints: Throughput target for product assistant: 40-60 qps sustained during peak, p95 chat latency target <250ms, fallback model acceptable for heavy bursts. They prefer Llama-family open models or Redwood-verified alternatives with 8-bit quantization.

Commercial / procurement: Mid-market purchasing cadence. Expecting CFO + Legal sign-off. Suggested committed M-12 contract (monthly invoice) or 12-month upfront. AE proposed estimated ARR range (60k-150k). Customer asked for example SOW and Dedicated pricing draft.

Open items: SOC2 artifact package, SAML metadata exchange, VPC peering diagram, final pricing and discount approval, sample SLA for Dedicated.
